en_US.title: Ran-Aegir Distance Model
en_US.scanner: Aegir is close enough to be reachable by 2190, far enough that help is history.
en_US.field_note: Use approximate route numbers as pressure, not as a decorative star chart.
en_US.terminal: ROUTE MODEL: Ran/Aegir is treated as a roughly 10.5 light-year class target from Sol. HECTON-8 play text uses Aegir; dry catalogs use RAN-B:H8. Exact ephemeris remains table work.
en_US.audio: Ten light-years is not far in astronomy. It is far enough to bankrupt a rescue.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The route model makes HECTON-8 hard sci-fi without turning the campaign into astronomy homework. Aegir can be reached by slow infrastructure, but not rescued casually. The player feels distance through debt, delay, custody, and local machinery.
en_US.external_site: The Ran-Aegir distance model sets the scale: reachable by infrastructure, unreachable by sympathy.

en_US.title: Probe Packet Travel Times
en_US.scanner: The first Aegir witnesses were packets, not colonists.
en_US.field_note: Unmanned craft can spend a career crossing a route before a person bets a body on it.
en_US.terminal: SURVEY CHAIN: beam-assisted probes and packet craft can cross first. They return stale truth, establish braking math, and let corporations sell a route before it is humane.
en_US.audio: The probe saw the ocean before anyone had a grave there.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Probe travel time is why Deep Reach could know HECTON-8 was valuable before it was safe. The first records are old, narrow and already financial.
en_US.external_site: Probe Packet Travel Times explain how Aegir became a claim before it became a place.

ru_RU.title: Время пробных пакетов
ru_RU.scanner: Первыми свидетелями Aegir были пакеты, не колонисты.
ru_RU.field_note: Беспилотник может потратить карьеру на маршрут до того, как человек поставит на него тело.
ru_RU.terminal: SURVEY CHAIN: beam-assisted probes and packet craft cross first. Они возвращают устаревшую правду, проверяют braking math и позволяют корпорациям продавать маршрут до того, как он станет humane.
ru_RU.audio: Зонд увидел океан раньше, чем там появилась первая могила.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Время пробных пакетов объясняет, почему Deep Reach знала ценность HECTON-8 раньше, чем его безопасность. Первые записи старые, узкие и уже финансовые.
ru_RU.external_site: Время пробных пакетов объясняет, как Aegir стал claim до того, как стал местом.

en_US.title: Heavy Freight Staging Time
en_US.scanner: Atlas-class freight is not fast. It is prepaid patience with armor.
en_US.field_note: A heavy route is assembled from depots, beam windows, braking mass and political nerve.
en_US.terminal: FREIGHT NOTE: Atlas/Seed cargo uses staging, pellet/fusion assist, long coasts and braking infrastructure. Public program dates can hide classified precursor launches and forward-domain departures.
en_US.audio: A ship that heavy does not travel. It becomes an invoice with a wake.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Heavy freight timing protects the timeline: Atlas can arrive before mass settlement because Deep Reach used precursor work, forward staging and unmanned risk tolerance.
en_US.external_site: Heavy Freight Staging Time keeps the no-FTL timeline plausible without convenient rescue ships.

ru_RU.title: Сроки тяжелого freight staging

en_US.title: Human Crew Rotation Transit
en_US.scanner: Humans do not commute to Aegir. They spend years being cargo with opinions.
en_US.field_note: A frontier worker sells time before they sell labor.
en_US.terminal: CREW ROTATION: human transport uses slow windows, shielded habitat sections, low-metabolic cycles or staged rotations. A missing worker is not an immediate call home; it is a delayed custody problem.
en_US.audio: By the time home asks where you are, the room has already flooded.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Crew transit explains why HECTON-8 could be abandoned for decades and still matter. The human cost moves slower than the claim ledger.
en_US.external_site: Human Crew Rotation Transit is the human side of no-FTL: labor becomes route debt.

ru_RU.title: Транзит смены экипажей
ru_RU.scanner: Люди не коммьютят на Aegir. Они годами являются грузом с мнением.
ru_RU.field_note: Фронтирный работник продает время раньше, чем труд.
ru_RU.terminal: CREW ROTATION: human transport uses slow windows, shielded habitat sections, low-metabolic cycles or staged rotations. Missing worker - не быстрый звонок домой, а delayed custody problem.
ru_RU.audio: Пока дом спросит, где ты, помещение уже затоплено.
ru_RU.in_game_wiki: Транзит экипажей объясняет, почему HECTON-8 мог быть брошен десятилетиями и все еще оставаться ценным. Человеческая цена движется медленнее claim ledger.
ru_RU.external_site: Транзит смены экипажей - человеческая сторона no-FTL: труд становится route debt.

en_US.title: Relay Message Lag
en_US.scanner: A message can be legally binding and still arrive too late to save air.
en_US.field_note: No ansible means truth moves as freight.
en_US.terminal: RELAY LAG: local Aegir messages can be hours or days. Interdomain legal packets can be years. Deep Reach pressure is therefore stale, automated, contractual and still dangerous.
en_US.audio: The reply is late. The lien is current.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Relay lag explains why Deep Reach can threaten the player without talking live. Contract machines, notaries and carrier clauses arrive before compassion.
en_US.external_site: Relay Message Lag makes communication a route system, not a magic voice channel.
